methodological_update.finding: Small exhaustive correctness alone is insufficient when the candidate compresses persistent/global state into a local-state heuristic.
methodological_update.next_protocol_rule: For a provisional rescue whose candidate omits an obviously persistent/global latent state, require either a proof-equivalent invariant or an independent scalable/reference oracle beyond bounded-small exhaustive before claim-grade promotion.

corroboration: Official construction assigns all path scores tightly as consecutive integers from 0 through C(2N-2,N-1)-1.
Official derivation uses lexicographic path ranking and consecutive score intervals, matching the frozen combinatorial-rank construction at the structural level.
Official editorial uses stable occurrence matching to obtain the inversion-minimal permutation P.
It requires cK >= inv(p) and cK congruent to inv(p) mod 2.
The opposite-parity optimum is obtained by one correspondence swap between equal values; its inversion increase is 1 plus twice a rectangle point count.
Only adjacent equal-value occurrences need be considered and all rectangle counts can be computed by sweep plus BIT in O(N log N), matching the frozen M0 structure.

arc214_f.score_change_policy: Post-freeze audit may downgrade a provisional verifier PASS when new independent authoritative evidence falsifies it; it may not retroactively upgrade a failed frozen arm.
arc214_f.structural_finding: The official exact solution is a wall-graph minimum vertex cut/maxflow formulation. The frozen local-state shortest-path correction does not model persistent destroyed-wall sets and is not exact.
